name: Brothers de Bregogne
source:
In 1387, Jehan de Bregogne marches south to reclaim his duchy from his illegitimate brother, Karel. But instead of siege or battle, Dijon offers him only a duel – one that will decide the fate of Bregogne.

[From [url=https://steelchill.itch.io/brothers-de-bregogne]Itch.io[/url]]
